0.original: Alisaie has only one thing on her mind.

24.original: Speak with Alisaie at Maelstrom Command.

48.original: Alas, the Ironworks crew couldn't linger long─far too much to do. Yet brief though our time together was, it was <hex:021A020203>bloody<hex:021A020103> good to see them!

51.original: At long last, we have our cure...

52.original: In theory, at any rate. We cannot be certain until such time as we put it to the proof, but I am quietly confident.

53.original: Well, if we're to test it on someone, then I suggest Ga Bu. His symptoms are relatively mild.

55.original: It'll be fine, I'm sure of it.

56.original: As long as you exercise due caution...

57.original: Yes. As long as we exercise due caution, it will be fine.

58.original: Without further ado, then, let's make for Limsa. We've kept Ga Bu waiting long enough!

59.original: I doubt I could contribute much towards what comes next, so I shall cheer you on from afar. Best of luck with the treatment.

60.original: We'll all be praying for your success!

61.original: 'Tis plain Alisaie is very fond of Ga Bu. To the extent that I have a hand in it, I shall do all in my power to bring him back.

62.original: Well, this is the moment of truth. I'll have our hosts bring Ga Bu to us at once.

63.original: Alisaie will succeed, I am certain of it. We need but have faith.

64.original: Well, this seems as good a spot as any to have a rest.
